text: Would young men avail themselves of the advice and experience of their old friends, they would find the utility in their youth, and the comfort of it in their more advanced age; but they seldom consider that, and you, less than anybody I ever knew.
author: Philip Stanhope, 4th Earl of Chesterfield
locator: Letter CCXXIV, to his son, Blackheath, June 27, 1758
